gloss: reduced working hours; shortened work schedule

definitions.gloss: reduced working hours; shortened work schedule
definitions.explanation: A work arrangement where an employee works fewer hours than the standard full-time schedule. Common for parents of young children, employees returning from leave, or as part of work-life balance policies.

examples.japanese: {時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: To apply for reduced working hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I am working reduced hours for childcare.

notes:
USAGE:
A common HR and workplace term in Japan. ⟦{時短|じたん}→時短：18970_jitan⟧ is an abbreviation of ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦{短縮|たんしゅく}→短縮：13665_tanshuku⟧ (time reduction). Legally guaranteed under Japan's Child Care and Family Care Leave Act for parents of children under three.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}{制度|せいど} (reduced hours system)
- {時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧ (to apply for reduced hours)
- {時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work reduced hours)
- {時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}する→復帰する：25395_fukkisuru⟧ (to return from reduced hours)
